description: Paylo's product changelog — the record of features, improvements and fixes shipped to the platform, newest first. Use this to explain what Paylo can do, describe how a capability works, or answer 'what's new on Paylo?'. Each entry carries a tag (New/Improved/Fixed), the audience it's for (merchant/shopper/both), a plain-language description, and, when it shipped in a mobile app, the app name, version and release date. Filter by audience, status, a 'since' date, or free text.

audience.description: Keep entries for sellers ('merchant') or buyers ('shopper'); either also includes shared ('both') entries.

query.description: Free text over entry title and description, e.g. 'wishlist', 'POS', 'bookings'.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only entries shipped on or after it.

name: get_changelog
